event_data.context: Final review can dead-end when a large plan response is truncated and the caller loses a lens subagent key, required model role, or result schema. Add idempotent read-only pending-assignment retrieval, include it in resume responses, improve targeted role-mismatch recovery, separate source-content scope from coordinator bookkeeping, and cover recovery at the MCP boundary.
event_data.summary: Let callers recover compact, exact final-review assignment provenance after large or truncated coordinator responses.
event_data.title: Make final review assignments reliably recoverable
